title: Sega Ages: OutRun
native_title: セガエイジス アウトラン
overview:
Vivid graphics. Exhilarating BGM. The ride-on driving game everyone has been waiting for is revived here!

The pinnacle of ride-on driving games, fully ported right down to its graphics, music and feel of control. Also includes an arranged version of the BGM by the original composer himself.

Take the wheel of a red convertible sports car and race the clock along sunny coastal roads, weaving through traffic. Reach each checkpoint to earn more time, and pick a branch at every fork in the road - your route decides which of five goals you reach.

Before you set off, tune the car radio to choose your driving music: Passing Breeze, Splash Wave or Magical Sound Shower.

- Options for difficulty, traffic, and manual or automatic transmission
- Original and arranged soundtracks
- Supports the Racing Controller and the analog Sega Multi Controller
- Memory backup

鮮やかなグラフィック。心弾むBGM。誰もが待ち望んだあの体感ドライブゲームがここによみがえる！

あの体感ドライブゲームの最高峰をグラフィック・音楽・操作感覚に至るまで完全移植。さらに原作曲者自ら手がけたアレンジバージョンのBGMも収録
